career_path_block.说明: Among the first to be replaced

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risks are crowds + safety, not AI. Peak congestion can cause incidents, while people retain on-site judgment.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risks are crowd volume + safety responsibility. Peak congestion can cause incidents, while on-site judgment and de-escalation still depend on people.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable systems become, lead attendants still use their eyes to decide where to intervene, their voices to calm complaints, and their hands to help guests. People cannot be fully removed from parks.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「客流 + 安全」——高峰拥挤易出事，但现场判断仍靠人。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「客流量 + 安全责任」——高峰拥挤易出事，但现场判断与安抚仍靠人。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪处该拦、哪客该救、哪投诉该哄，最后还是服务长的眼去看、嘴去说、手去帮——乐园这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but bites and conflict. Field conditions are unpredictable, but people still make response decisions.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risks are bites and conflict. Field conditions are unpredictable, but people still make response decisions.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how smart systems become, animal control workers still decide which animal to capture, which owner needs guidance, and which conflict needs de-escalation. Their eyes assess, their hands control, and their words calm the scene. People remain essential to animal control.

skills: Public education on responsible pet ownership

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「被咬 + 冲突」——现场不可控，但处置判断仍靠人。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「被咬 + 冲突」——现场不可控，但处置判断仍靠人。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪只该抓、哪主该劝、哪冲突该缓，最后还是管制员的眼去看、手去控、嘴去说——管制这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.说明: Stable work volume but thin margins
Craft premium and low rework rate
AI damage assessment reduces manual work

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but process change. Traditional body-and-paint technicians who cannot repair aluminum bodies and electric vehicles face removal from the market.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI but industry structure. Insurers are shifting from repair-first practices toward standardized part replacement, while new body structures and materials raise process barriers. Integrated-cast electric-vehicle bodies are expensive and unfamiliar to repair. Technicians who fail to follow new technology become marginalized.
risks: Insurance-claim rule changes reduce traditional body-and-paint volume
Dust and paint harm occupational health
High repair barrier for integrated-cast electric-vehicle bodies
Standardization pressures purely manual body and paint work

page.contract_project_risk_block: Repair shops commonly use employment contracts + piece-rate commissions. Before starting, confirm piece rates, paint-protection equipment, and occupational-health examinations. Insurance-claim collaboration also requires clear settlement terms.

responsibilities: Perform sheet-metal work, painting, and glass installation
Control paint quality and delivery schedules
Protect structural safety and pass reinspection
skills: Glass and panel removal and installation

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「工艺换代」——学不会铝车身和新能源修复，传统钣喷师傅会先被市场淘汰。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大风险不是 AI 而是「行业结构」——保险公司力推「以修代换」转向标准件更换，车身结构与新材料让维修工艺门槛提高；同时新能源汽车一体压铸车身维修成本高、工艺新，跟不上新技术的师傅会被边缘化。
risks: 保险理赔规则变化压缩传统钣喷单量
粉尘油漆危害职业健康
新能源一体压铸车身维修门槛高
赶交车压力与返工风险
纯手工钣喷被标准化挤压

page.contract_project_risk_block: 维修厂用工以劳动合同 + 计件提成为主，入职确认计件单价、油漆防护装备与职业病体检安排；涉及保险理赔协作要明确结算方式。

responsibilities: 执行钣金喷漆与玻璃安装
控制漆面质量与交车周期
保障结构安全与复验达标

career_path_block.说明: Growth direction with a strong pay premium

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but skills remaining limited to traditional powertrains. Electrification and intelligent systems are creating a short transition window, and technicians who do not change direction face structural displacement.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is not AI but industry transformation. Electrification and intelligent systems change the structure of vehicle-development roles. Demand for traditional chassis and engine testing shrinks, while battery, electric-drive, and software-testing roles grow. Technicians who fail to transition become marginalized.
risks: Industry transformation: traditional powertrain test roles shrink
Routine overtime: test milestones and road-test timing are unpredictable
Income ceiling: technician advancement is more limited than engineer advancement
Knowledge updates: electric powertrain and software technologies change quickly
Physical demands: noise, grease, and long-distance road tests

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can process one week of test data in one hour, but people still provide the engineering intuition to place a prototype on the bench and isolate anomalies by hand.

responsibilities: Maintain test equipment and safety procedures

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「技能停在传统动力」——电动化和智能化的转型窗口就这几年，不转方向的技术员会被结构性淘汰。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「行业转型」——电动化和智能化改变整车研发的岗位结构，传统底盘与发动机试验需求收缩，电池、电驱、软件测试岗在增长，不跟上转型就会被边缘化。
risks: 行业转型：传统动力试验岗位收缩
加班常态：试验节点与路试时间不可控
收入天花板：技术员相对工程师有限
知识迭代：三电与软件技术更新快
身体消耗：噪声、油污与长途路试

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能在一小时内处理完你一周的试验数据，但把样车推到台架、把异常亲手定位出来的那份工程直觉，还是得靠人。

responsibilities: 维护试验设备与安全规程

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but automated machines and convenience stores. Machines absorb standard drinks, while people with flavor expertise and guest relationships become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest career risk is not AI but automated coffee machines and convenience-store or fast-food coffee. Machines absorb standardized drinks, while independent cafes still need people to deliver flavor and experience.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how fast machines become, baristas still decide how to blend beans, texture milk, and connect with guests. Human thought, hands, and explanation remain essential behind the bar.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「自动机 + 便利店」——标准杯被机器吃，有风味和客情的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「自动咖啡机 + 便利店/快餐咖啡」——标准化出品被机器吃，独立咖啡馆仍要人做风味和体验。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管机器多快，豆子怎么拼、奶泡怎么打、客人怎么聊，最后还是咖啡师的脑去想、手去做、嘴去讲——吧台这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.说明: Replaced by AI and emerging leaders
career_path_block.路径: Manager who relays messages but avoids decisions

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but performance commitments + unstable tenure. Success and failure are assigned to the CEO.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI, but performance commitments + unstable tenure. Market value and KPI results directly affect the role, and a strategic error or industry turning point can trigger board replacement. High pressure and uncertainty are constant.
risks: Performance commitments: KPI results directly affect tenure
Industry turning points: strategic errors trigger leadership changes
Continuous high pressure damages physical and mental health
Public sentiment and crises can erupt at any time

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent dashboards become, the CEO still decides whether to bet on a market and whether to act at a turning point. The top role cannot shed human accountability.

responsibilities: Make major investment and acquisition decisions
Report to the board and represent the organization

career_path_block.路径: 只传话不决断的管理者

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「业绩对赌 + 任期不稳」——成败都算在你头上。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「业绩对赌 + 任期不稳」——市值和 KPI 直接挂钩，战略失误或行业拐点就可能被董事会换掉，高压和不确定性是常态。
risks: 业绩对赌，KPI 直接挂钩去留
行业拐点，战略失误即换帅
高压昼夜连轴，身心损耗

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管看板多聪明，该不该赌这条赛道、敢不敢在拐点拍板，最后还是 CEO 的肩膀扛——一号位这头，人撤不干净。

responsibilities: 对董事会汇报并代表企业

career_path_block.说明: Die making and repair are durable craft skills

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI alone, but staying in operation without learning setup. Setup technicians with CNC and die skills become more valuable in automated workshops.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest job risk is not AI alone, but safety + transition. Press equipment carries high injury risk and little tolerance for error, while automated lines and CNC machines replace pure manual operation. Button-only operators face the greatest displacement risk.
risks: High injury risk and low error tolerance in press operations
Noisy, oily workshop conditions and heavy physical demands
Shift and overtime work disrupt schedules
Skills that do not advance create a clear pay ceiling

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can schedule, record data, and adjust process parameters, but people install the die and read the first-piece caliper result. Machines calculate parameters; they cannot carry quality responsibility.

responsibilities: Install and adjust dies and parameters

career_path_block.说明: 手动环节被自动化替代

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「停在操作不学调试」——会数控、懂模具的调试工，在自动化车间里越来越值钱。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「安全与转型」：冲床类设备工伤风险高，容错率低；同时自动化产线和数控机床在替代纯手动操作，停留在「只会按按钮」的操作工最容易被淘汰。
risks: 冲压作业工伤风险高，容错率低
纯手动操作岗被自动化替代
车间环境噪音油污，体力消耗大
倒班与加班常见，作息不规律
技能不升级则收入天花板明显

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能排产、能录数据、能调工艺参数，但模具装进冲床那一下、首件卡尺量出来的那个数，靠的是操作工的手和眼。机器算得出参数，担不了质量。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is digitization + self-service. Systems absorb records and scheduling, while assistants with strong aseptic practice and chairside coordination remain more stable. Use this assessment for career exploration only, not diagnosis, hiring, or employment decisions.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI but digitization + self-service. Intraoral scanning and intelligent scheduling replace some records and appointments, while people remain necessary for chairside support and infection control.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable systems become, Dental assistants still perform four-handed dentistry, control suction, sterilize instruments, and reassure patients. Chairside care retains a substantial human role. This is career exploration guidance, not a diagnostic, hiring, or employment decision.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「数字化 + 自助」——记录排程被吃，有无菌与配合力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大的风险不是 AI，而是「数字化 + 自助」——口内扫描与智能预约替一部分记录排程，但椅旁配合与感染控制仍要人。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，椅旁四手、吸唾控野、灭菌消毒和患者安抚，最后还是助理的脑和手去定——椅位这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.说明: Task-heavy work; growth depends on the institution

career_risk_cards.callout: The main career risk is the vitality of the community, not AI. AI can build schedules but cannot create shared commitment. Strong tools cannot compensate for a community that loses connection. Use this guidance for career exploration only, not diagnosis, hiring, or employment decisions.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest career risks are organizational stability and funding, not AI. Roles depend on member donations and volunteer participation. Budget changes, staff turnover, and lower participation affect stability, while cross-cultural and public controversies demand careful judgment.
risks: Funding dependence: institutional budget changes affect roles
Generational attrition: participation among younger members declines
Relationship boundaries: pastoral care requires careful limits
Limited income: some positions are part-time or volunteer
Public sensitivity: social issues can create controversy

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can schedule activities, send notices, and organize course materials, but only people understand why someone enters a community and chooses to remain. Human connection remains central. Use this outlook for career exploration only, not diagnosis, hiring, or employment decisions.

career_risk_cards.callout: 这份工作最大的风险不是 AI，而是「社区的活力」——AI 排得了课表，但聚不拢人心；人心散了，再好的工具也没用。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「组织与经费」——依赖会众奉献和志愿者投入，经费波动、人员流动、代际参与度下降都会影响岗位稳定性；同时跨文化和社会争议议题也考验分寸。
risks: 经费依赖：机构预算波动影响岗位
代际流失：年轻会众参与度下降
责任边界：牧养关系中的分寸难题
收入有限：部分岗位为半职或志愿性质
舆论敏感：社会议题容易引发争议

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能排活动、能发通知、能整理课件，但「一个人为什么走进来、又为什么愿意留下来」——这份人心，只有人能懂。

responsibilities: 统筹宗教活动与教育事务

career_path_block.路径: Community Group-Buying Coordinator / stall owner + private customer network

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is relying only on volume instead of building a business. Transactions move online, while sellers who choose products well, understand people, and retain repeat customers can withstand channel change.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI alone but declining foot traffic and the absence of base pay. E-commerce and delivery platforms keep more buyers online, while AI customer service and vending machines handle standardized sales. Sellers who select products well, understand people, and retain repeat customers are more resilient.
risks: No base salary and highly variable income
E-commerce and vending machines divert customer traffic
Local enforcement and permit rules vary by area
Outdoor exposure and high physical demands
Livestreaming and group buying compress pure volume selling

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI customer service can take orders and vending machines never rest, but a person still has to read reactions, close the sale, and turn a stranger into a repeat customer. Street commerce remains a people business, and machines cannot replace personal trust.

responsibilities: Select and source products and adjust the merchandise mix
Sell door to door or from stalls
Collect and reconcile payments and manage restocking
Maintain repeat customers and complete compliance requirements
skills: Online tools and private customer-community operations

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「只会跑量不会经营」——交易会线上化，会选品、懂人情、能经营熟客的从业者，才扛得住渠道变革。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「客流下滑 + 无底薪保障」——电商和外卖把客流留在线上，扫码支付让摊贩少了现金生意，而 AI 客服与自动售卖正接管标准化售卖；会选品、懂人情、能经营熟客的从业者更稳。
risks: 电商与自动售卖分流客流
城管与合规政策区域波动
纯跑量模式被直播和团购压缩

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 客服能接单、自动售卖机不休息，但「看人脸色把东西卖出去」、把陌生人聊成熟客的那个人，还得是你——街头生意是「人」的生意，人情味机器替代不了。

responsibilities: 选品进货并调整货品组合
上门推销或摆摊现场售卖
维护熟客并办理合规手续

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but monitoring combined with simulation. Platforms absorb manual work, while engineers who design systems and calculate returns become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest job risk is not AI but the combination of monitoring and simulation. Systems replace manual meter reading and automate modeling, while people still select solutions, calculate returns, and coordinate retrofits.
risks: Cross-functional coordination is difficult to automate

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable systems become, Energy Engineers still decide what to upgrade, how to calculate returns, and who will coordinate implementation. Efficiency work cannot remove people from the process entirely.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「监测 + 仿真」——手工被平台吃，会设计能算账的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「监测 + 仿真」——系统替人工抄表、自动建模，但判方案、算回报、协调改造仍要人。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪块该改、怎么算回报、谁去协调，最后还是能源的脑去想、手去推、责去负——能效这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is knowing only chainsaw work and not machinery. Licensed, experienced Fallers who operate harvesters and use drone-based plans can gain stability during the transition.
career_risk_cards.fact: The largest risks are worksite safety and harvesting policy, not AI. Logging is among the occupations with the highest injury risk. Natural-forest bans and harvest quotas also reduce work volume. Mechanized harvesting and drone planning are expanding, but people still make cutting and safety decisions on difficult terrain. Licensed, experienced Fallers have greater stability.
risks: Natural-forest harvest bans and restricted volume
Strong seasonality and lower winter income
Difficult mountain conditions and long commutes

page.contract_project_risk_block: Drones can survey a forest and AI can estimate harvest volume, but when a large tree starts to crack, Fallers still rely on experience to choose an escape direction and adjust the cut. Tree felling allows no careless step. Machines cannot replace this judgment.

responsibilities: Survey trees and determine fall direction
Coordinate skidding and follow safety standards

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「只会油锯、不懂机械」——懂采伐机、会用无人机规划、持证的老伐木工，在转型期反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「作业安全与采伐政策」——伐木是工伤风险最高的职业之一，天然林禁伐、限额采伐政策也在压缩作业量；机械采伐和无人机规划在普及，但复杂地形的锯木判断和现场安全靠人，持证的老伐木工更稳。
risks: 天然林禁伐，采伐量受限

page.contract_project_risk_block: 无人机能提前看清林子、AI 能算采伐量，但大树「咯吱」一响的那几秒，往哪边躲、锯口怎么补，还得靠伐木工的经验。伐木是「跟树讲道理」的活，树倒人退，一步都错不得——这份判断，机器替代不了。

responsibilities: 配合集材并执行安全规范

career_risk_cards.callout: The risk for postsecondary health teachers is not replacement by AI but exhaustion from evaluation. As AI grows stronger, clinical instruction and mentorship become scarcer.
career_risk_cards.fact: The main risks are entry barriers and evaluation. Doctorates, residency backgrounds, research metrics, and academic promotion create layered pressure, including up-or-out systems. AI-assisted instruction changes teaching formats, but clinical teaching and mentorship remain difficult to replace. Teachers will shift from lecturers to instructional designers.
risks: High entry barrier: doctorate and residency background
Evaluation pressure: up-or-out systems and research metrics
Fragmented time: simultaneous teaching and research

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can generate slides, but it cannot create the moment a student's eyes light up. Education and clinical instruction always require people.

career_risk_cards.callout: 高校健康教师的风险不是被 AI 取代，而是「被考核拖垮」——临床带教和育人能力，是 AI 越强越稀缺的部分。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位风险主要是「门槛与考核」：博士学历、规培背景、科研指标、职称评审层层压着，非升即走压力大；同时 AI 辅助教学会改变授课形态，但临床带教和育人职责短期不可替代，教师会从「讲台上的讲者」变成「教学的设计者」。
risks: 门槛高：博士学历、规培背景
考核压力：非升即走与科研指标
时间碎片：教学科研两头烧
AI 冲击：讲授型价值下降

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 生成得了课件，生成不了「学生眼睛亮起来的那一刻」——育人和带教，永远需要人。

career_path_block.说明: Transition toward technical work and process design

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk for machinists is not AI but workplace injury and occupational health. No matter how valuable the craft, safety must remain the first machine you protect.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is not AI but equipment and operating hazards. High-speed cutting tools, flying metal chips, and poorly secured workpieces can cause injuries after a moment's inattention. Long-term exposure to cutting fluids and noise also creates occupational-health risks.
risks: Equipment-operation hazards: cutting tools, metal chips, and workholding accidents
Occupational health: noise, cutting fluids, and prolonged standing
Demanding workshop work: environment and schedules
Rapid technical change: equipment upgrades require continuous learning

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can write programs extremely quickly, but only the person beside the machine knows whether the tool will chatter on contact or how a batch of material will respond to cutting. Machines cannot calculate every aspect of process craftsmanship.

responsibilities: Interpret drawings and develop machining plans
Maintain equipment and participate in process improvement
skills: Workholding, tool setting, and process planning

career_path_block.说明: 被数控自动化持续替代

career_risk_cards.callout: 机械师最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「工伤与职业健康」——再值钱的手艺，也要先保住安全这台机床。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「设备与操作风险」——高速旋转的刀具、飞溅的铁屑、夹持不牢的工件，稍不留神就是工伤；长期接触切削液和噪声还有职业病隐患。
risks: 设备操作风险：刀具、铁屑、夹持事故
职业健康：噪声、切削液、长期站立

车间工作辛苦：环境与作息
技术更新快：设备换代需要持续学习

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能把程序编得飞快，但「刀下去的那一刻会不会震、这批料吃不吃刀」，只有站在机床边的人知道——工艺这门手艺，机器算不出来。

responsibilities: 保养设备并参与工艺改进

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is templates and SaaS absorbing standard events. Strong coordinators remain more stable.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is 'templates + SaaS.' Platforms and templates compress standardized event work and create price transparency and margin pressure, while large complex projects still require human coordination.
risks: Customer relationships are easy to lose

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent platforms become, planners still decide which events to accept, how to turn them into partnerships, and how to handle emergencies. Human minds plan, legs move, and hands control event delivery.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「模板 + SaaS」——标准会务被平台吃，有统筹力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「模板化 + SaaS」——标准化会务被平台与模板压缩，且价格透明、利润受压；同时大型复杂项目仍要人统筹。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管平台多聪明，哪类活动值得接、怎么讲成合作、现场突发怎么扛，最后还是策划的脑去想、腿去跑、手去控——活动这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but automated testing + in-line sensors. Instruments absorb routine testing, while people with root-cause and release capabilities become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI, but automated testing + in-line sensors. Instruments replace routine laboratory testing, while people remain responsible for deviation root-cause analysis and release decisions.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent instruments become, analysts still must decide which deviations to stop, how to trace root causes, and who signs release authorizations, using their eyes to review, minds to judge, and hands to sign. People cannot be fully removed from quality control.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「自动检测 + 在线传感」——常规化验被仪器吃，有溯源和放行力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「自动检测 + 在线传感」——常规化验被仪器替代，但偏差的根因分析与放行责任仍要人负。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管仪器多聪明，哪个偏差要拦、怎么追到根因、放行单谁来签，最后还是分析师的眼去看、脑去判、手去签——质量这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but simulation + automated programming. Systems absorb standard debugging, while people with integration skills are better positioned.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI but simulation + automated programming. Systems accelerate standard debugging, while roles concentrate around multidisciplinary engineers who understand integration. People who only teach robots face pressure.
risks: Pure teaching work is under pressure
Cross-functional accountability can be shifted between teams

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent systems become, engineers still use judgment, hands-on tuning, and fieldwork to decide which scenarios are worth pursuing, balance accuracy and cost, and take responsibility across systems. People cannot be removed entirely from automation.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「仿真 + 自动编程」——标准调试被系统吃，有集成力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大风险不是 AI，而是「仿真 + 自动编程」——标准调试被系统加速，且岗位向懂集成的复合工程师集中；纯示教的人被挤压。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪类场景值得做、精度成本怎么取舍、跨系统的锅谁背，最后还是工程师的脑去想、手去调、脚去跑——自动化这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.可控: Use AI for speed, shift toward judgment

career_risk_cards.callout: Risk stays manageable when engineers respect accountability boundaries and keep learning. Their moat is execution and judgment, not repetitive work.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest job risk comes from medium-risk exposure and unclear accountability, not AI. People remain responsible for engineering judgment and final review; AI handles only structured tasks.
risks: Pressure from accountability and compliance boundaries in the Ship Engineers field.
Structurable tasks are being replaced faster by AI.
Industry swings and tighter headcount or posts.
Knowledge turns over quickly and needs constant refreshing.

page.contract_project_risk_block: Split moderate risk into what you can learn and what you can control: methods are learnable, process and compliance are controllable.

responsibilities: Develop and execute work plans related to Ship Engineers.
Take responsibility for the quality and risks of Ship Engineers outputs.
Coordinate resources and drive delivery of Ship Engineers projects.
Review and improve Ship Engineers processes and methods.

skills.说明: Use AI and professional software well

career_path_block.可控: 用 AI 提效、转向判断

career_risk_cards.callout: 风险可控的前提是「不越责任边界 + 持续补课」——工程师的护城河在执行与判断，不在重复劳动。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大风险不在 AI，而在「中风险敞口 + 责任边界」——工程师的判断与终审仍由人承担，AI 只处理可结构化任务。
risks: Ship Engineers领域的责任与合规边界压力。
可结构化任务被 AI 加速替代。
行业波动与编制/岗位收紧。
知识更新快，需持续补课。
跨角色协作的沟通成本。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 把中风险拆成「可学 + 可控」两块：可学的是方法，可控的是流程与合规。

responsibilities: 制定与执行Ship Engineers相关的工作方案。
对Ship Engineers产出质量与风险负责。
协调资源、推动Ship Engineers项目交付。
复盘优化Ship Engineers流程与方法。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but electrification + declining gasoline engines. The machines you repair are becoming less common.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI, but electrification replacing gasoline engines + declining gasoline-engine repair. Landscaping and outdoor equipment are shifting toward battery power, so traditional small gasoline-engine repair volume will decline over the long term.
risks: Outdoor equipment electrification reduces gasoline-engine repair
Long-term exposure to oil and exhaust creates health risks
People who only repair old gasoline engines are replaced
Seasonality creates uneven workloads at shops
Young people avoid the field, aging the workforce

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent the diagnostic tool becomes, people still disassemble carburetors, adjust idle speed, and travel to the site. Small machines do not repair themselves simply because someone reads a code.

responsibilities: Inspect and repair lawn mowers, chainsaws, and other small gasoline engines
Replace wear parts and tune equipment

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「电动化 + 油机萎缩」——你修的机器本身在变少。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「电动化替代 + 油机萎缩」——园林和户外设备正转向电池动力，传统小油机维修量长期看跌。
risks: 户外设备电动化，油机维修萎缩
长期接触油类废气，有健康风险
只修老油机的人被替代
门店随季节波动忙闲不均
年轻人不愿入行，队伍老化

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管诊断仪多聪明，化油器还是人拆的、怠速还是人调的、现场还是人去的——小机器不会因为读码就自己修好。

responsibilities: 检修割草机链锯等小油机
skills: 化油器与燃油系统调校

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not rapid replacement by AI, but IVR and automation gradually consuming transfer work. Complex inquiries and reception remain essential.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is IVR plus automation. Voice navigation and automated switchboards consume standard transfers, shrinking pure call-routing roles, while complex inquiries, reassurance, and in-person reception still require people.
risks: Roles are readily combined with other duties

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent systems become, operators still decide how to reassure an urgent caller, which visitors should be admitted, and how departments should coordinate. Their ears listen, their voices respond, and their composure stabilizes the contact. People cannot be fully removed from communications.

responsibilities: Record messages and answer on others' behalf

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI 快替，而是「IVR + 自动化」慢慢吃转接——但复杂查询与接待仍刚需。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「IVR + 自动化」——语音导航和自动总机吃掉标准转接，纯接转岗位在缩；但复杂查询、安抚与现场接待仍离不开人。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，那通急事怎么安抚、访客谁接谁不接、部门间怎么协调，最后还是接线员的耳去听、嘴去说、心去稳——联络这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is AI. IVR and speech recognition consume standard transfers, while people with judgment and reassurance skills become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is IVR plus speech recognition. Self-service voice systems consume standard directory assistance and transfers, substantially reducing roles; only complex triage and reassurance still require people.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent systems become, operators still determine intent, calm emergencies, and find the right person. Their ears listen, their minds judge, and their voices respond. People cannot be fully removed from communications.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险是 AI：IVR 与语音识别吃掉标准转接，有判断与安抚力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「IVR + 语音识别」——自助语音吃掉标准查号与转接，且岗位被大幅压缩；只有复杂分流与安抚还需人。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，意图怎么判、紧急怎么安抚、找谁最对，最后还是接线员的耳去听、脑去判、嘴去说——联络这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but prefabrication + standardization. Prefabricated systems replace square tiles, while skilled craftspeople become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI, but prefabrication + modular construction. Modular bathrooms and prefabricated interiors take standard installation work, but people remain necessary for irregular shapes and premium stone.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent tools become, craftspeople still identify hollow tiles, finish irregular shapes beautifully, and repair substrate defects on site. Human hands, eyes, and judgment cannot be fully removed from installation.

responsibilities: Calculate waste and clean the site

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「装配 + 标准」——方砖被预制替，有手艺人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「预制 + 装配」——整体卫浴与装配式装修在吃标准铺贴；但异形与高端石材仍要人。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管工具多聪明，哪块砖空鼓、怎么把异形收漂亮、现场怎么补坑，最后还是师傅的手去敲、眼去看、脑去调——铺贴这头，人撤不干净。
